title: The salt shaker only had 3 holes - salt pours out
text: The salt shaker only had 3 holes - salt pours out. The product from this Seller - the Salt dispenser, the one with the white cap, has only 3 holes in it and caused salt to pour out.

product_metadata.title: Shake It Free Shaker Glass Moisture Proof Humidity Free Salt, Pepper and Spice Shakers by Tumbler Home
features: The Shake It Free Shakers feature a self-closing hinged lid that seals, keeps humidity out and your spices dry. Every shake of the Shake It Free Shakers brings you an even stream of salt or spice, EVERYTIME!
Textured bee hive shaped glass for ease of holding and one-handed use design
Sturdy self-closing hinged lid Wide mouth for easy refills
Unique lid lining to seal each hole from moisture
Moisture proof top keeps contents dry for smooth, easy shaking on picnics, camping, boating or out to the patio - no spill & no clog. Great for travel.
